DOCKSTATION_VERSION.description: Version number for dockstation. Used to sync between schema, dotfiles version, and dockstation.

HOST_APP_DIR.description: The path to the project directory on your host machine.

BASE_IMAGE.description: The base Docker image that includes your project dependencies.

DEV_IMAGE_NAME.description: A descriptive name for your development environment image (e.g., vim_env_go_tutorial).

PLUGINS_DIR.description: Directory to hold plugins installed in the container.

DOTFILES_BASENAME.description: Relative path to the directory containing a specific git checkout of your dotfiles repository. Can be a plain checkout or a git worktree.

DOTFILES_DIR.description: The absolute path to your dotfiles repository on the host machine.

VIM_DOTFILES_DIR.description: Directory within the dotfiles repository containing Vim configuration files.

VIM_RC_FPATH.description: Path to the .vimrc file within the Vim dotfiles directory.

VIM_CONFIG_DIR.description: Path to the .vim/config directory within the Vim dotfiles directory.

BASH_HISTORY_FPATH.description: Path to the bash history file for the mounted directory. Follows the convention: ~/bash_histories/${DEV_IMAGE_NAME}-bash_history.

COC_DATA_DIR.description: Location where COC plugins store extension data.
